title: Clique Connect
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 2 \leq K_i \leq N; \sum_{i=1}^{M} K_i \leq 4 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_{i,1} < A_{i,2} < \dots < A_{i,K_i} \leq N; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; All input values are integers.
